snippet.title: Evercade - Activision Collection 2 - Trailer
snippet.description:
15 more hits from the dawn of gaming, licensed by Activision!

Activision returns to Evercade with another collection of '80s classics. Includes H.E.R.O., Pitfall II: Lost Caverns, Stampede and more!

Pre-order today!
£19.99, $29.99, €24.99
Find out more: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/activision-collection-2/
